title: Website Security Cleanup Allowance: Included, Guarantee and Paid Cleanups
content:
**Rule.** Included cleanups belong to each Harborline SiteGuard plan separately and are never pooled across a customer's plans, and a cleanup of one site never draws on another site's plan. A cleanup is included while the number of the plan's cleanups recorded as included in the current subscription year is below the tier's included cleanups per subscription year, a re-infection within the tier's re-infection guarantee days of the previous completed cleanup is cleaned free and counted as guarantee, and any other cleanup is paid at the tier's extra cleanup fee.

## The count of included cleanups

- **Window.** The current subscription year runs from the latest anniversary of the plan's opening date on or before today, up to today. In the first year the opening date itself starts the window.
- **What is counted.** The cleanups of this plan recorded as included whose moment of completion falls in that window.
- **Allowance and fee.** The included cleanups per subscription year and the fee per cleanup beyond those included are the figures of the plan's own Website Security tier.

A paid cleanup is billed to the plan as one extra cleanup charge.

## Illustrations (hypothetical allowance of 3 per subscription year)

| Hypothetical situation | Basis |
|---|---|
| 1 cleanup recorded as included in the current subscription year; the cleanup is not a re-infection within the guarantee days of a previous completed cleanup | Included, since 1 is below 3 |
| 3 recorded as included in the current subscription year; the cleanup is a re-infection 12 days after the previous completed cleanup, guarantee days 30 | Guarantee, cleaned free |
| 3 recorded as included in the current subscription year; the cleanup is not a re-infection within the guarantee days | Paid at the tier's extra cleanup fee |

## Subscription year boundary (hypothetical dates)

A plan opened on the 20th of a month has its subscription years start on the 20th of that month in each later year. A cleanup recorded as included on the 19th of that month one year on belongs to the first subscription year; from the 20th, the count starts again from zero.

## Separate plans (hypothetical)

A customer protects two sites with two plans. The first plan has used its whole allowance for the year; the second has used none. A cleanup of the first site is not included on the strength of the second plan's allowance, because a cleanup of one site never draws on another site's plan.
